classification_contract.diagnostic_group: A deterministic mechanical mismatch family; membership alone does not prove its causal semantic.
classification_contract.root_leaf: A first-divergence or compound row in the replay, not automatically a proven causal root.
classification_contract.causal_confidence: PROVEN demonstrates the mismatch origin; STRONG_CANDIDATE identifies the best-supported attribution still requiring a causal experiment.
classification_contract.replacement_semantics: Tracked separately from causal confidence; every current production replacement remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
classification_contract.sanitization: Per-record leaf pseudonyms replace source identifiers; absolute source and STO coordinates are omitted; durations and lags are coarse classes.

root_cause_groups.name: multi-resource calendar-union approximation
root_cause_groups.semantic: The first divergences coincide with activities whose stored task span equals the stored assignment-span envelope while STO uses its documented union of resource calendars.
root_cause_groups.mechanical_grouping_basis: First-divergence rows carry ACTIVITY_RESOURCE_CALENDARS_UNITED; source-coordinate replay closes the dependent rows assigned to this family.
root_cause_groups.causal_confidence_basis: The shape and stored assignment arithmetic strongly identify this semantic, but no independent assignment-driven counterfactual has removed the root divergence.
root_cause_groups.next_experiment: Define an assignment-driven canonical scheduling contract and an independent oracle before replacing the documented calendar-union approximation.

root_cause_groups.name: inactive-activity logic boundary
root_cause_groups.semantic: The first divergences occur on active rows adjacent to relationships removed with inactive endpoints; the stored Project coordinates retain effects on active rows on both sides of those inactive rows.
root_cause_groups.mechanical_grouping_basis: First divergences occur at inactive endpoint boundaries; source-coordinate replay closes dependent date rows and isolates predecessor Free Slack residuals.
root_cause_groups.causal_confidence_basis: Adjacency and replay make this the strongest candidate, but no native causal experiment has established the inactive-row rule that removes both forward and late/free-float divergences.
root_cause_groups.next_experiment: Use a minimal native Project matrix around active-to-inactive-to-active FS chains; the already-tried zero-duration pass-through rule worsened BOILER.

evidence.source_date_float_replay: predecessors of excluded inactive endpoints retain two direct Free Slack residuals

root_cause_groups.name: elapsed-duration float basis
root_cause_groups.semantic: On both BOILER elapsed rows the stored TotalSlack and FreeSlack equal elapsed coordinate gaps, while production measures float as working time.
root_cause_groups.mechanical_grouping_basis: Source-date float replay leaves only the elapsed-duration rows as direct float residuals.
root_cause_groups.causal_confidence_basis: With identical stored early/late coordinates, elapsed coordinate subtraction reproduces the source slack while production working-time arithmetic produces the residual.
root_cause_groups.next_experiment: Add an independent elapsed-duration float conformance case before carrying an elapsed-float flag through PlannedActivity and result fingerprints.

root_cause_groups.name: multi-resource/inactive total-float convergence
root_cause_groups.semantic: One Total Float slot consumes an early coordinate assigned to the inactive-boundary family and a late coordinate assigned to the multi-resource family.
root_cause_groups.mechanical_grouping_basis: The Total Float minimum consumes early and late coordinate families assigned to G2-RC02 and G2-RC01 respectively.
root_cause_groups.causal_confidence_basis: Its confidence is capped at STRONG_CANDIDATE because both parent causal attributions remain candidates.
root_cause_groups.next_experiment: Resolve its two parent causes; it is not an independent fix.

next_action.name: inactive-activity logic boundary
next_action.required_experiment: A minimal native Project matrix for active-to-inactive-to-active FS logic, covering both forward placement and predecessor late/free-float influence.
next_action.required_regression: The isolated matrix must establish one rule that predicts both sides of the inactive row; do not reuse the rejected zero-duration pass-through guess.
